componentAcceptance: All T19 criteria are covered. agentApiMajor=2 returns MACHINE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED with requiredAgentApiMajor=1 and actualAgentApiMajor=2. An incompatible MCP result returns MACHINE_MCP_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED with requiredMcpProtocolVersion=2025-11-25 and the actual error. The call wrapper preserves the compatibility message and details. Each negotiation fails after one request, creates no operation and leaves a valid existing machine record intact. The previously omitted remote-machines suite is now registered in npm test, and the complete root regression is 1974 tests / 1889 pass / 0 fail / 83 skipped.
productAcceptance: T19 passes at integration level: version mismatches produce explicit compatibility guidance without automatic reconnect loops or state damage. Formal scores are 0/20 work packages, 12/63 scenarios and M0 11/12.
implementation: Grant issuance and machine ping distinguish API major incompatibility from machine identity mismatch and return required/actual versions.
MCP version refusal returns the required protocol and actual error. The call wrapper preserves that message and details instead of collapsing to a bare code.
Both negotiations are one-shot failures with no operation and no valid-record deletion or corruption.
remote-machines.native.mjs is now registered in npm test, so these cases and the existing machine suite run in the full regression.
testRuns: Final npm test: phase one 1590/1586/0/4 and phase two 383/300/0/83; total 1974 tests, 1889 pass, 0 fail, 83 skipped.
preservedFailures: The first MCP test exposed that call() discarded details and guidance. The wrapper now preserves both and the suite passes.
The initial full run also showed that remote-machines.native.mjs was absent from npm test. Registration was corrected before accepting T19.
limitations: This proves bounded version refusal and guidance, not a live old-production-Agent migration or every future protocol version.
No real model inference, production process, push or release was used.
